title: The same requirement built twice, in two places
story: A and B both build the bulk discount, for the same requirement. A puts it in lineCents() in pricing.ts; B applies it where the quote is served, in index.ts. Each alone is right. Together, a quote for ten takes 10% off twice.

a.why: ten or more of an item take 10% off

fact.sentence: Ten or more of an item take 10% off the line, before VAT is added

b.why: ten or more of an item take 10% off (my own take)

resolution: Keep one implementation: B's discount in the route is removed.
